items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think it was him and Hub Cap and Roy Haines and Richard Davis or someone.

ctx.x: And I knew the name of the Alvin Hotel. It was also across the street, a caddy- corner from Birdland. Actually, some of the rooms would face down on Broadway where Birdland was. But anyway, Booker happened to be playing there that night, so just the Gods blessing me again. It was a Monday night, and he was playing in the jam session band. I think it was him and Hub Cap and Roy Haines and Richard Davis or someone. I don’t know who was playin’ piano. So I went down to Birdland, I said, “Booker, I’m here!” And his…
Oh boy, such great music, yeah.
